messages:
infra-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — Elevated 5xx spike detected for gateway /generate in us-west-2. 5xx rate = 12% over 5m. Paging: maria (oncall). Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/ingress
maria (oncall): on it. @devon @sanjay please ack. any immediate customer reports?
devon (sre): ack. looking at metrics now — scheduler queue depth (batcher-pool-usw2) jumped ~10x at 03:41 UTC. tail latency and request timeouts spiked. suspect head-of-line blocking in batching layer.
anya (prod-eng): CS just flagged a few customers reporting timeouts and 502s. they forwarded a customer trace that matches the time window.
sanjay (runtime): quick grep of batcher logs shows repeated "kv-cache eviction stalled" messages and long GC pauses on a couple of pods. sample:
```
2026-03-15T03:41:02Z batcher-7f5c9 WARN EvictionLoop: stalled for 1243ms, pending_entries=8421
2026-03-15T03:41:06Z batcher-7f5c9 ERROR handler request_id=abc123 timeout while awaiting kv-handler
2026-03-15T03:41:09Z batcher-7f5c9 INFO BatchAssembler: assembling batch_size=230 latency=312ms
```
sanjay (runtime): seems large batches + kv-cache churn -> some workers stuck trying to materialize KV pages, causing HOL.
maria (oncall): for mitigation - two immediate levers: route to fallback smaller model variant, and reduce max_batch_size on the affected pool. Which should we do first?
devon (sre): do both in parallel. fallback model reduces memory/latency impact; smaller batches reduce HOL. I'll start rollout for fallback-model-usw2 now.
deploy-bot: command acknowledged: `/rollout --region=us-west-2 --model=fallback-2q --policy=gradual` — rollout started :rocket:
maria (oncall): applying batcher config change on pool batcher-pool-usw2: BATCH_MAX_SIZE 256 -> 64. keep the rest of regions unchanged.
sanjay (runtime): running change:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/batcher-pool-usw2 BATCH_MAX_SIZE=64 --record
``` 
sanjay (runtime): also kick eviction script on the busy pods to force kv-cache cleanup:
```
./tools/kv-evict --selector=batcher=pool-usw2 --grace=2s
```
infra-bot: Autoscaler action: +2 instances added to dedicated-pool-usw2 (scale up triggered) — expected capacity available in ~90s.
devon (sre): watching queues — backlog is starting to drop. 5xx rate now 6.8% (1m window) down from 12%. keep an eye on cross-region routing impact.
maria (oncall): customer-impact summary for CS: ~10% of requests in us-west-2 saw increased latency/502s during spike window (03:40–03:48 UTC). affected tenants: TEN-112, TEN-987, TEN-301. @customer-success please post advisory and tag accounts.
customer-success: drafting short note now, will post and DM sales for impacted accounts. sending top-5 tenant list to SRE for postmortem.
anya (prod-eng): do we need to failover traffic to another region temporarily? that will cause higher user latency but may stop errors for some tenants.
devon (sre): not necessary yet — backlog is draining and fallback rollout is ~40% done. If 5xx doesn't continue to drop in next 5m we can proxy traffic to eu-west-1 as emergency.
maria (oncall): agreed. continue monitoring. devon/sanjay you own triage and root cause, anya you own customer comms + postmortem notes.
sanjay (runtime): capturing heap/trace from two pods with highest stalled counts. uploading to traces: https://traces.redwood.example/trace/0f3b
sanjay (runtime): preliminary hypothesis: a regression in the KV page eviction path combined with unusually large batch assembly sizes on some long-tail requests.
devon (sre): marking incident S2. adding runbook reference: https://runbooks.redwood.example/batching-hol
maria (oncall): timeline so far — 03:41 alert -> 03:43 mitigation started (fallback + reduce batch size + scale up) -> 03:47 eviction and drain actions -> 03:52 5xx reduced to ~3.2%. ETA for stable recovery: 20–30 minutes. :white_check_mark:
devon (sre): I'll create an incident ticket and attach logs/heapdumps/traces and assign to runtime for fix. quick note: consider adding safeguard to limit max_batch_size auto-tuner to avoid sudden jumps.
customer-success: public customer advisory posted. linking here: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/4832109876
maria (oncall): leaving this thread for incident channel. will hand off to devon for longer-term RCA. if anyone notices regression or 5xx creeping back, ping me and escalate to S1.
infra-bot: INCIDENT NOTE saved (S2) — link: https://incidents.redwood.example/4832109876/notes :card_file_box:
maria (oncall): good job team, thanks for fast mitigation. :thumbsup:
